title: The Plan Forecast Planning Decisions Report: planning decisions, decision times and refusal reasons by council and kind of work
description:
Planning decisions, decision times and the reasons councils gave for refusing applications, by council and kind of work, for 9 English councils: the data of The Plan Forecast Planning Decisions Report, October 2026 edition, counted by Plan Forecast (planforecast.co.uk) from the councils' own planning registers, decisions from October 2023 to September 2026.

Counts only: no application reference, address, postcode, proposal text, council wording or person's name.

The report: https://planforecast.co.uk/research/planning-decisions/2026-10
